name: test-kit
description: Playwright accessibility, contrast and visual-regression checking logic, extracted so it belongs to none of its consumers. frontend-web, packages/storybook and (eventually) frontend-admin each supply their own list of pages or stories and call the same functions here — none of them holds the WCAG/APCA tags, the screenshot options or the summary reporter itself. See docs/frontend/02-component-testing-architecture.md for why this cannot live inside any one of them.
//: @playwright/test is a peer dependency, not a regular one: test() registrations only reach a consumer's own Playwright CLI run if they come from the exact same module instance that CLI resolves. A second copy here would silently register tests nobody's runner ever collects.
